title: scirpus cespitosus subsp. austriacus
intro: Scirpus cespitosus subsp. austriacus, commonly known as Austrian club-rush, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and supporting digestion. The therapeutic actions of Scirpus cespitosus subsp. austriacus include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and spasmolytic properties, which help in relieving coughs, colds, and asthma symptoms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
